deployment.firstDeploy: Only deploy when no vision worker is already running.
deployment.updates: Stop/deactivate the old worker revision and verify all its replicas have terminated before starting a replacement. ACA single revision mode and maxReplicas=1 alone do not prevent rollout overlap.
deployment.overlap: Concurrent writers are unsupported. Observation metadata and conditional frame downloads fail closed for mismatched bytes but do not serialize Cosmos publication.

health.readyWhen: model loaded and cloud polling loop healthy within 120 seconds

runtime.acrContext: Caller must stage only vision/__init__.py, worker.py, detector.py, seed_model.py, requirements.txt, run-config.json, Dockerfile and licenses/*.txt under a vision directory. Exclude .local, authoring, assets and credentials. Older az acr build clients may ignore Dockerfile.dockerignore. This task does not run Azure builds.
runtime.credentials: ManagedIdentityCredential with required user-assigned AZURE_CLIENT_ID; no keys, developer credentials, local truth, resource creation or runtime weight download

model.seedCache: Reuse an existing validated manifest without Hub access. Otherwise resolve only config.json, preprocessor_config.json and model.safetensors from the pinned local snapshot; download missing artifacts only. Runtime Detector always uses local_files_only.
model.manifest: manifest.json with modelId, revision and SHA-256 hashes of config.json, preprocessor_config.json and model.safetensors; validated before model load
model.licenses: vision/licenses contains Apache-2.0 license text and model attribution; copied into the detector image
model.buildContext: vision/Dockerfile.dockerignore excludes .local, credentials, source assets, authoring environments, frontend and backend from this image build

pilot.input: PIL.Image or HxWx3 uint8 NumPy array in RGB order
pilot.outputNote: Example shape only, not a measured detection. Boxes are normalized xyxy against input pixels. No downloads are attempted by Detector.
pilot.realModelTestNote: Opt-in smoke uses a tiny synthetic JPEG fixture, not a people-count benchmark. It blocks network connections and verifies the actual CPU model measures exactly the pixels decoded from the unchanged uploaded bytes. The existing 24-frame media pilot is separate.

sampling.activation: activeUntil must be in the future; otherwise a same-epoch request aged 0 to less than 30 seconds grants one attempt per camera in this worker process
sampling.requests: New timestamps supersede older requests; successful or unavailable publication consumes that camera's request. Requests are not mutated. Restart can reprocess an unexpired request.
sampling.source: Continuous clock helper: running (elapsedSeconds + max(0, now-updatedAt) * speed) % 60; paused elapsedSeconds % 60. Worker floors to 15 fps PTS with floor(seconds * 15) / 15, bounded to frame 899. Extraction and observation sourceSeconds use that PTS; 59.999 samples 59.93333333333333.
sampling.staleGuard: Re-read clock/request after download, before inference, after inference before warming publication, after warming before Blob upload, and after upload before final Cosmos upsert. Discard changed epoch/layout/variant and expired or superseded request-only work.
sampling.crossServiceWrites: Allocate the ready observation ID before upload. Before overwriting frames/{cameraId}.jpg, successfully publish a guarded warming observation with people null, detections [], frameUri null and the epoch/layout/variant envelope. Upload JPEG bytes and metadata {observationid: readyObservation.id} atomically in one upload_blob call, then persist that same ready observation ID in Cosmos. Failed warming publication prevents upload. Stale work after upload or a rejected final Cosmos write leaves warming; upload errors publish unavailable with no counts. A timed-out write may have committed. Backend must require ?observation=<id>, compare metadata.observationid, download the same ETag with IfNotModified, and return X-Vitrine-Observation-Id only for matching bytes. A replaced frame must fail closed, never fall back to latest bytes. frameSha256 is diagnostic only. Clock changes during final network writes remain possible; backend epoch/layout filtering is required. No distributed worker lease: stop-before-start updates are mandatory.

media.cachePolicy: LRU eviction with space reserved before streaming; conditional ETag download; oversized/partial downloads discarded; owned leftover artifacts cleared on startup
media.extractor: ffmpeg accurate seek at max(0, quantized sourceSeconds - 0.000001), formatted to six decimals so rounding never seeks past the target PTS; one JPEG, aspect-ratio-preserving 1280x720 bounds, 20-second timeout
media.pixelIdentity: Decode extracted JPEG for inference, then upload the identical JPEG bytes without re-encoding.

qualitativeVision.note: Optional direct GPT qualitative vision is deliberately omitted. No GPT calls occur. Person counts and boxes come only from RT-DETR; backend-hosted Foundry agents are a separate component.

failure.errors: All caught stage failures, including those published as unavailable, emit explicit allowlisted vision_error codes only; no URLs, tokens or exception/SDK messages
failure.clockUnavailable: Stop sampling; never substitute a local clock or overwrite with guessed epoch/layout.
